verdict.rationale: LiteLLM is itself an SDK. Its library exposes a single completion() interface across providers and returns OpenAI-format responses. The proxy also works with the openai-python SDK for streaming and function-calling, so developers can build against an official client library. missing for 10: evidence of SDKs in languages beyond the Python library, SDK reference/API docs depth (typed clients, versioning), and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK developer experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Call any provider using the same completion() interface, with no API to re-learn for each one
Every response follows the OpenAI Chat Completions format, regardless of provider.
Drop-in OpenAI compatibility — swap providers without rewriting your code
proxy supports streaming and function-calling in the same way as the openai-python SDK
